olivia_pm: Heads-up team — planning Olivea dedicated slice rollout in quiet-window Tue 03:30-03:50 UTC. Need final approvals for runtime pin, KV priming, KMS hold, and rollback triggers.

olivia_pm: Plan summary: canary 10% (2 nodes) -> widen to slice. Runtime: rwinference-2.4.1-rc3 (commit 9f3a2b4d). Quiet window 03:30-03:50Z, rollback monitoring until 04:10Z. KMS hold requested until 04:45Z.

deploy-bot: PROPOSED JOB CONFIG:
```
customer: olivea
slice: olivea-dedicated-slice-7
runtime: rwinference-2.4.1-rc3
commit: 9f3a2b4d
canary: 2 nodes (10%)
window: 2026-04-07T03:30:00Z -> 2026-04-07T03:50:00Z
rollback_watch_until: 2026-04-07T04:10:00Z
rollback_conditions:
  - p99_latency_ms > 500
  - error_rate > 1%
  - host_mem_usage > 85% for 2m
kms: HOLD KMS-OLIV-KEY until 2026-04-07T04:45:00Z
kv_priming: run prefix-warmers 10m before window
post_canary_smoke: auto-run smoke suites before widening
alerts_to: #eng-oncall, #customer-success
```

sam_ops: Quota check: reserved 3x A100s for the slice. Confirmed. I'll pre-warm autoscaler +20% headroom for first 10m.

maria_eng: Approve runtime pin. rc3 fixes KV eviction under memory pressure which is critical for Olivea's workload.

lin_sre: Add host memory rollback (see deploy-bot config). Also insist on automated smoke-tests gating before widening the canary. I'll own the post-canary checklist (p99, KV hitrate, GPU memory, ingress 5xx).

olivia_pm: Jake, Olivea has a scheduled org KMS rotation at 03:45Z — can they delay until 04:45Z? Need confirmation to place hold.

jake_success: Olivea sec confirmed they can postpone rotation to 04:45Z but asked for written confirmation we won't rotate keys. Please ensure KMS ops ack the hold.

andre_prod: Release notes snippet ready: "Deploy rwinference-2.4.1-rc3 to Olivea dedicated slice. Includes KV eviction fix and improved latency stability. Canary + auto-rollback gating. Contact CS if regressions observed." Approve to publish to release notes?

sam_ops: :white_check_mark: on publishing and schedule.

maria_eng: :white_check_mark: Approve runtime pin and release note. Small telemetry name change (metrics.v2 -> metrics.v2_4) not blocking.

lin_sre: :white_check_mark: I'll be on-call during window. I'll post the runbook link in a minute.

jake_success: :white_check_mark: Customer KMS hold confirmed.

deploy-bot: DEPLOYBOT: canary start scheduled 2026-04-07T03:30:00Z. Will gate widen on auto-smoke pass and no rollback conditions.

olivia_pm: Action items before start: (1) olivia to trigger KV priming at 03:20Z, (2) lin to run post-canary checklist, (3) sam to monitor capacity.

maria_eng: PR 4821 created — pins runtime and includes runbook + rollback steps.

lin_sre: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/olivea-dedicated-rollout-4821 — contains smoke commands and dashboards to watch.

deploy-bot: STATUS (03:20Z): pre-canary priming running. kv-warmer: queued 120 prefixes -> pushed to 2 nodes.

sam_ops: Monitoring capacity, standing by to add spare nodes if we hit headroom.

olivia_pm: Thanks all. This thread will be the single source of truth for approvals and quick notes during the window. I'll post a short post-mortem if anything unexpected happens.

(deploy-bot will post further updates during canary)
